name: To Ironforge for Yagyin's Digest

meta.next: The Star, the Hand and the Heart (Alliance)
next_q: The Star, the Hand and the Heart (Alliance)

summary: Theldurin the Lost sends you to Ironforge with a sigil. In a shop in the Forlorn Cavern, Gerrig Bonegrip is meant to take you for one of the people Theldurin fled, so you can ask him for Yagyin's Digest.

sections.title: A Book Written Long Ago
sections.body: The Tablet has taught Theldurin much, yet questions remain. Yagyin wrote a digest ages ago, and the people Theldurin fled keep copies in many places. Their most learned study it. Theldurin believes its vast knowledge can offer protection, so he wants you to bring it back.

sections.title: The Shop in the Forlorn Cavern
sections.body: Gerrig Bonegrip keeps a shop in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern. Theldurin gives you the Sigil of the Hammer to show Gerrig. Then Gerrig should take you for one of the people Theldurin fled. Ask him for Yagyin's Digest.

sections.title: Gerrig's Greeting
sections.body: Gerrig Bonegrip warns you to watch what you touch in the shop. Knowledge can be deadly. When you show the sigil, Gerrig greets you as brother or sister and praises the dwellers beneath.

faq.q: Why does Theldurin want Yagyin's Digest?
faq.answer: The Tablet tells Theldurin much, yet leaves questions unanswered. Yagyin's digest, written ages ago, holds vast knowledge that can offer protection. Theldurin wants you to bring it back.
In Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern, where he keeps a shop.

faq.q: What is the Sigil of the Hammer used for?
faq.answer: Theldurin gives you the Sigil of the Hammer to show Gerrig Bonegrip. He wants Gerrig to take you for one of the people Theldurin fled.

faq.q: Where does this fit in the chain?
aliases: what comes before to ironforge for yagyins digest
faq.answer: It follows Solution to Doom with Theldurin the Lost. The chain continues with the next step.
